result.title: NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation
result.summary: Intracortical brain-computer interfaces can drive robotic arms, but they keep the user inside the fast sensorimotor loop: every approach, correction, and grasp must be neurally specified. Whether intracortical population activity can instead serve as a task-level condition for a learned embodied policy, without symbolic commands or hand-designed skill libraries, remains unknown. NI-ACT addresses this question with a hierarchical brain-embodied framework: a brief motor-cortical signal is read once as a persistent intent, and a visuomotor policy then closes the perception-action loop from vision and proprioception. In a counterfactual grasping task where the scene cannot specify the target, the neural intent alone determined which object the robot grasped; replacing the intent changed the behavior accordingly. Passing the full population latent as a dedicated intent token, rather than a one-hot decoded direction, raised grasp completion from 69% to 81% over 132 held-out scenes, whereas a continuous direction alone did not improve on a one-hot label. Where the signal was read also mattered: in one dual-array session, with the readout window matched, premotor (PMd) intent completed more grasps than primary motor (M1) intent (77% vs. 53%), and the conventional post-cue M1 readout reached 42%. Preparatory activity was itself sufficient: in a center-out task, intent read only from PMd before the go cue (that is, before any movement) drove complete grasps, and in one recording it completed more grasps than the same animal's post-cue readout. These results show that how a neural signal is represented, and where and when it is read, jointly determine how effectively it conveys movement goals to an embodied agent.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出分层「脑-具身」框架：先把一段运动皮层信号一次性读取为持久的意图表示，再由视觉-本体感知的 visuomotor 策略闭环完成抓取，并在反事实抓取任务中比较全群体 latent 与 one-hot 方向标签、不同读出脑区与读出时机的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「完整 latent 作意图 token 优于离散标签」及「读出位置与时机的差异」可能为 LVR 中 latent 承载何种任务信息、以及读取 latent 状态的时机与位置提供类比线索，但属脑机接口与机器人领域，需核查是否真与视觉推理状态有关。
